comment: The platform definition of the acquisition PC (Chapter 25, ADR 0020): everything below MiniDAQ that the installed system must be, with exact versions. A change here is a platform change: a change request with the SOUP review of Chapter 14, a new id, new update bundles built for it. tools/platform_check.py compares a running system with this file and writes the platform's SBOM.

kernel.note: The Ubuntu 24.04 general-availability kernel series (assumption: confirm with team: the exact kernel build, and whether a real-time kernel is wanted, Chapter 4).
